def _create_pending_order(event, expires, **kwargs):
    return Order.objects.create(
        code='EXP1', event=event, email='dummy@dummy.test',
        status=Order.STATUS_PENDING, locale='en',
        datetime=now(), expires=expires,
        total=Decimal('12.00'),
        sales_channel=event.organizer.sales_channels.get(identifier="web"),
        **kwargs
    )


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_expiry_warning_sent_within_window(event):
    event.settings.mail_days_order_expire_warning = 3
    djmail.outbox = []
    o = _create_pending_order(event, now() + timedelta(days=2))
    send_expiry_warnings(None)
    assert len(djmail.outbox) == 1
    assert djmail.outbox[0].to == ['dummy@dummy.test']
    o.refresh_from_db()
    assert o.expiry_reminder_sent
    assert o.all_logentries().filter(action_type='pretix.event.order.email.expire_warning_sent').exists()


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_expiry_warning_sent_only_once(event):
    event.settings.mail_days_order_expire_warning = 3
    djmail.outbox = []
    _create_pending_order(event, now() + timedelta(days=2))
    send_expiry_warnings(None)
    send_expiry_warnings(None)
    assert len(djmail.outbox) == 1


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_expiry_warning_not_sent_outside_window(event):
    event.settings.mail_days_order_expire_warning = 3
    djmail.outbox = []
    o = _create_pending_order(event, now() + timedelta(days=10))
    send_expiry_warnings(None)
    assert len(djmail.outbox) == 0
    o.refresh_from_db()
    assert not o.expiry_reminder_sent


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_expiry_warning_disabled_when_days_zero(event):
    event.settings.mail_days_order_expire_warning = 0
    djmail.outbox = []
    _create_pending_order(event, now() + timedelta(days=1))
    send_expiry_warnings(None)
    assert len(djmail.outbox) == 0


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_expiry_warning_skipped_after_deadline(event):
    event.settings.mail_days_order_expire_warning = 3
    djmail.outbox = []
    _create_pending_order(event, now() - timedelta(days=1))
    send_expiry_warnings(None)
    assert len(djmail.outbox) == 0


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_expiry_warning_uses_payment_deadline(event):
    event.settings.mail_days_order_expire_warning = 3
    event.settings.payment_term_expire_delay_days = 5
    djmail.outbox = []
    # The order expires in 2 days, but the payment deadline is 5 days later, so no warning is due yet.
    o = _create_pending_order(event, now() + timedelta(days=2))
    send_expiry_warnings(None)
    assert len(djmail.outbox) == 0
    o.refresh_from_db()
    assert not o.expiry_reminder_sent


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_expiry_warning_skips_non_pending_and_approval_orders(event):
    event.settings.mail_days_order_expire_warning = 3
    djmail.outbox = []
    _create_pending_order(event, now() + timedelta(days=2), status=Order.STATUS_PAID)
    _create_pending_order(event, now() + timedelta(days=2), require_approval=True)
    send_expiry_warnings(None)
    assert len(djmail.outbox) == 0
